detail: `git init` and `git diff` exit 69 with "You have not agreed to the Xcode license agreements" — /usr/bin/git is the Xcode shim and no other git is on this machine's PATH (/opt/homebrew/bin/git and /usr/local/bin/git do not exist). Affected in the cli-2.17 worktree: test/tools.test.ts 3 failures (the twining_commits git-repo describe block, beforeAll git init) and test/integration/tools/housekeeping-tools.test.ts all 15 failures (gitInit in beforeEach). Both fail at git invocation before any Twining code runs, so they are NOT caused by the 2.17.0 extraction — but neither can they be shown green from here. Anything else that shells out to git (twining_record scope inference, twining_commits existence probe, RecordSyncManager.headSha) is equally untestable in this sandbox, which is also why the new CLI tests deliberately avoid git.
summary: git is UNUSABLE in this agent sandbox (Xcode license shim) — 18 git-dependent tests fail environmentally; controller must re-run them
